SPEC.md 7.2 items 2 and 10 do not order payload validation against the authorisation decision, and 8.3 gives permissionDenied for a requester who is not authorised, so this vector accepts malformedRequest, permissionDenied or (where the task's front matter names one) the task's own standing code, and fixes no check order.
